name: arena_router_mcp
description: OpenAI-compatible proxy for arena.ai — 131 closed model (GPT-5.x, Claude, Gemini, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen) через браузерную автоматизацию. Streaming SSE, magic-link login, API-key auth.

google_bridge_login.method: uses existing Google session in Chrome profile, clicks through OAuth consent, no password/2FA automation

safety.api_key_auth: optional via ARENA_PROXY_API_KEY env var on the proxy host
safety.browser_automation: all requests go through arena.ai's public web UI
safety.google_bridge_login: uses existing Google session in Chrome profile, no password/2FA automation, no CAPTCHA bypass
safety.magic_link_login: fallback — user must manually click the email link and paste URL back
safety.captcha_handling: returns 503 with code=captcha when reCAPTCHA appears
safety.serial_queue: one request at a time (single browser session)

categories: MiniMax, Mistral, ByteDance, Tencent, Xiaomi, Baidu, NVIDIA, IBM, etc.

use_cases_in_octopus: octopus-ai-rewriter — улучшение описаний навыков через сильную модель
experience-analyst — анализ накопленного опыта через gpt-5.2-high
skill-factory-ai — генерация новых навыков через сильные модели
proactive-self-modification — bounded self-improvement через reasoning models
complements: ollama (локальные модели: qwen2.5, llama3.2 — бесплатно, быстрее)
